svg.title: Look up a boat’s next stop with two tools
svg.desc: A tool is a function the model can ask for data. The answer from one lookup can supply the next one. First lookup. Ask the boat-name tool for Wren’s ID. It returns V42. Second lookup. Ask the route tool for the next stop for V42. It returns Cove. Report. Wren’s next stop is Cove. If the ID is missing, stop before the route lookup.
svg.text: Look up a boat’s next stop with two tools
A tool is a function the model can ask for data. The answer from one lookup
Ask the boat-name tool for Wren’s ID. It returns V42.
Ask the route tool for the next stop for V42. It returns Cove.
Wren’s next stop is Cove. If the ID is missing, stop before the route lookup.
